name: Soundbeam 6
description: Accessible touchscreen instrument with ultrasonic sensors, wireless switches and built-in sampled sounds.
hardwareControls: Up to four sensor inputs and eight wireless switches
notice: Use the touchscreen to select a Soundset and configure sensor and switch behavior. Built-in sounds can be played through the audio outputs without an external MIDI sound module. The USB socket is documented for file transfer; this profile does not claim class-compliant USB MIDI or a verified external MIDI route. For external integration, consult the current manual and manufacturer for your software version. Notes, channels and expression depend on the selected setup; this profile supplies setup guidance rather than a fixed note or CC map. Select this profile manually: port names have not been verified. The panel is an original conceptual schematic, not a scaled drawing of the physical controls.
